records.key: This object moved from {old} to {name} in this frame.
records.source: This object moved from {old} to {name} in this frame.
records.translation: 此对象在此帧中已从 {old} 移至 {name}。

records.key: {name} already continues through its other daughter; undo that first or select the other daughter.
records.source: {name} already continues through its other daughter; undo that first or select the other daughter.
records.translation: {name} 已通过另一个子细胞延续；请先撤销该操作，或选择另一个子细胞。

records.key: {name} already labels another object in this frame; one identity can mark only one object per frame.
records.source: {name} already labels another object in this frame; one identity can mark only one object per frame.
records.translation: {name} 已在此帧中标记了另一个对象；一个身份在每帧中只能标记一个对象。

records.key: {old} now carries {name} through the division; Undo restores it.
records.source: {old} now carries {name} through the division; Undo restores it.
records.translation: {old} 现在在分裂之后延续 {name}；撤销可将其恢复。

records.key: {old} was merged into {name}; Undo restores it.
records.source: {old} was merged into {name}; Undo restores it.
records.translation: {old} 已合并到 {name}；撤销可将其恢复。
